07b52e38400bda0f72ed393ad8b26b35ae79d5fe.summary: A 2015 CrowdStrike blog post by Dmitri Alperovitch describes HURRICANE PANDA, a China-based adversary the author says it has investigated since 2013. The actor targeted several large telecommunications and technology companies. The report recounts how CrowdStrike's incident response and endpoint monitoring repeatedly stopped the actor's attempts to regain access after remediation. It mentions a Windows kernel zero-day, CVE-2014-4113, which the actor used without success. The post is written as a deterrence case study and ends by promoting the CrowdStrike Falcon product.
